candidate.purpose: optional image-embedding similarity evidence for burst reranking

weight_artifact.sha256_status: not published by pinned repository or observed artifact headers
weight_artifact.pin_rule: ETag and Last-Modified are transport metadata, not immutable byte pins; capture SHA-256 before any use or packaging

licensing.basis: Pinned model card labels model License Apache License 2.0; repository LICENSE is Apache-2.0
licensing.separate_binary_notice: not found in pinned model card or repository source reviewed
licensing.data_terms: LVD-142M training data terms are separate and no training data is redistributed
licensing.attribution_gate: retain pinned model card, repository license, artifact URL, byte count and captured SHA-256 in attribution before packaging

source_architecture_default.note: hub constructor default only; it does not define an Ember photo-crop policy

input_contract.larger_input_rule: model card permits dimensions divisible by 14; nonmultiples are cropped to closest smaller multiple
qualification_conditions: 224x224 using exact pinned classification evaluation transform
518x518 as separate condition with transform frozen and recorded before comparison
input_contract.crop_warning: 224 and 518 are separate preprocessing conditions, not equivalent inputs; center crops can remove faces, blink evidence or intentional blur context

model_contract.position_encoding: learned class-plus-patch table with bicubic interpolation for other grids; interpolate_offset 0.1 and antialias false in pinned non-register hub path
model_contract.output: final LayerNorm class token plus patch tokens; source does not return a quality score
model_contract.similarity_operation: qualification may L2-normalize 384-D CLS embeddings then compute cosine; this is evaluator logic, not a learned aesthetic prediction

applicability.supported_use: nearest-neighbor or pairwise visual similarity as optional burst evidence
applicability.evidence: pinned model card lists image retrieval using nearest neighbors
applicability.style_and_blur_policy: treat similarity behavior on personal style, motion blur, shallow depth of field and soft focus as unknown; retain classical scores and human review; model must not set catalog.best or reject an image
applicability.paper_metrics: model-card ImageNet and Oxford-H metrics are separate tasks and must not be reported as Ember or burst accuracy

reuse: Candle Tensor, Device, Module and LayerNorm operations
existing segment safetensors VarBuilder and verified-weight plumbing
existing Metal feature path on macOS and CPU fallback path
candle_port.checkpoint_boundary: official artifact is PyTorch .pth; existing segment loader expects safetensors, so conversion and tensor-name/shape audit are qualification work; no conversion was performed here
operator_inventory: class token and learned position table
reshape, transpose, concat and L2 normalization
candle_port.existing_segment_difference: segment/src/vit.rs is SAM3-specific: 32 layers, 1024 hidden, 16 heads, 1008px input, 2-D axial RoPE, window/global attention and convolutional feature output; DINOv2-S/14 is a separate 12-layer, 384-D, 6-head class-token ViT and is not a drop-in replacement

platform_reality.macOS_Metal: existing Candle Metal route can be reused in principle; operator support, memory and latency are UNMEASURED
platform_reality.Windows_CPU: existing Candle CPU route can be reused in principle; memory and latency are UNMEASURED
platform_reality.selection_rule: measure both paths on held-out bursts before any product selection; do not infer suitability from architecture alone

required_before_use: obtain artifact under approved license review
capture SHA-256 and verify exact 88283115-byte artifact
convert or obtain an equivalent safetensors representation without adding runtime dependencies
compare reference outputs for 224 and 518 preprocessing separately
label held-out bursts for technical keeper, intentional-style keeper and tie/uncertain
measure pairwise accuracy, tie coverage, blur-preservation rate, p50/p95 Metal and Windows CPU latency, peak memory and cold/warm costs
require abstention on low margin or disagreement; retain baseline order
qualification_gate.no_ship_claim: this record qualifies a candidate for an experiment; it does not qualify model accuracy or a shipped feature

minimal_implementation_task.scope: offline evaluator only; no catalog, pipeline or dependency edits
steps: Add a separate DINOv2-S/14 module beside, not inside, SAM3 ViT code using existing Candle 0.9.2 dependencies
load only a SHA-256-verified converted artifact through existing weight plumbing
implement exact patch embedding, class token, position interpolation and 12 standard blocks from pinned source
emit final-normalized 384-D CLS embedding and cosine pair scores for 224 and 518 conditions
compare against existing 8x8 luma signature on held-out bursts; expose score and uncertainty as review evidence only
minimal_implementation_task.acceptance: reference parity, artifact hash, license record and platform measurements are recorded before any consideration of shipping
